distorted_text: Our biggest client left this week and told us her company was cutting all outside suppliers, so this loss is on me and I need to change how I plan work.

distorted_text: I feel like a failure as a founder, and we have made a profit for three years and hit most goals we set, so maybe this business isn't working.

distorted_text: I feel out of place at this investor conference, and it turns out it's only for early-stage clothing brands like ours, so we probably don't belong here.
